data.title: About guest records.
items: Does it work if guests didn’t book on Catch?
Yes. Import guest lists or connect Luma, and check-ins at your door count the same. Groups are worked out from who actually came.
Three or more events checked in over the last 180 days. Every group shows its rule, so you know why someone is in it.
Can my team see the records?
People you add to your team can, with the access you give them. Door staff only see the list for their event.
Can I add notes about a guest?
Yes. Notes are private to you and your team, and never shown to the guest.
Can I see who spends the most?
Not yet. Catch doesn’t rank guests by spend; it shows attendance, who brings friends and who’s reachable.
Yes, whenever you like, as a file.
